name: External Entities Manager
description: Provides an administrator interface to External Entities enabling field discovery and synchronization of local content.
project_description:
Synopsis 
 This module provides an administration interface to manage External Entities. It enables the synchronization of Drupal content from external entities as well as external entities inspection. It can be useful to determine available entity fields that can be mapped and detect incorrect mappings. It also provides the ability to auto-synchronize external entities with their corresponding local Drupal entities at a given frequency or manually. It enables batch operations on external entities such as accessing all (to load cache copy) or opening/saving all to trigger actions. Finally, it can provide some statistics on external entities (counts, etc.).

 Requirements 
 
 External Entities 
 
 Recommended modules 
 
 External Entities Wikibase plugin 
 External Entities Database plugin 
 External Entities Files plugin 
 External Entities Image File (exif) Storage plugin 
 External Entities TSV Files Storage plugin 
 External Entities JSON Files Storage plugin 
 External Entities Yaml Files Storage plugin 
 External Entities XML Files Storage plugin 
 External Entities Breeding API (BrAPI) plugin 
 External Entities Multiple Storages plugin
